listings.name: Queen City Riichi — Japanese Mahjong at Element Eatery
listings.description: Japanese Riichi Mahjong on alternate Sundays at Element Eatery, run by Queen City Riichi. Riichi blends luck and strategy and differs from the original Chinese rules; players of all levels are welcome.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Cincinnati, verified on the hosting group's events page: 2 upcoming sessions, Sunday 13:00-16:00, with Meetup recording "Every 2 weeks on Sunday until December 31, 2026". STYLE IS STATED, and is riichi rather than american: the description reads "Discover the exciting world of Japanese Mahjong ... a unique twist on the original Chinese rules" and credits Queen City Riichi, qcriichi.com. The website points at the organiser's own site rather than the Meetup group, which is a general-interest group that merely hosts the event.

listings.name: St Charles Public Library — Weekly Mahjong
listings.description: Weekly Tuesday afternoon mahjong at St Charles Public Library. A limited number of tiles and league cards are provided — bring your own set and card if you have them.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Naperville, verified on the library's own Meetup events page: 3 upcoming sessions, Tuesday 13:00-15:00, Meetup recording "Every week on Tuesday until December 29, 2026". Recorded as american because the description offers "league cards", which is the National Mah Jongg League card.

listings.name: Star Branch Library — Mah Jongg Stars
listings.description: A casual American Mah Jongg group at the Star Branch of Ada Community Library, Monday mornings from 10:15am. Ages 18 and over.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Boise. Style, day, time and the age limit are all stated in the event description: "Join our casual group in playing American Mah Jongg. Mondays at 10:15 am - 12:15 pm For ages 18+". ONE OF THE TWO POSTED DATES IS MISTYPED: the 31 August event is entered as 22:15-00:15 while the 14 September one is 10:15-12:15. A library session running to a quarter past midnight is not credible, and the description says 10:15 am, so the morning time is used and the evening record treated as the organiser's AM/PM slip. Discovery produced these as two separate candidates because it keys sessions on start time.

listings.name: American Mahjongg NoVa — Wednesday Night Woodbridge
listings.description: Weekly Wednesday evening American Mahjongg in Woodbridge, run by the American Mahjongg NoVa group. All skill levels welcome, including complete beginners. The venue address is shared with members after RSVP rather than published.
listings.howToJoin: Join the Meetup group and RSVP; the address is given to attendees on RSVP.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Arlington, verified on the group's own events page: 5 upcoming sessions, Wednesdays 18:00-20:00. Style is stated — "Welcome to the American Mahjongg NoVa Group!" — as is the welcome to beginners: "If you are just starting and have no idea what a crak or bam is". Meetup records no series; five consecutive Wednesdays are what makes it weekly. NO ADDRESS ON PURPOSE: the events carry "venue": null with eventType PHYSICAL, so the organiser has not published one; the city is the group's own registered city.

listings.name: Kennett Square Locals — Mahjong
listings.description: Afternoon mahjong hosted at the organiser's home in the Kennett Square area, through the Kennett Square Locals Meetup group. NOT OPEN TO NEWCOMERS: the organiser requires that you have already met them at a previous event of the group before you can attend this one, and the address is sent privately. Table space is limited and depends on someone bringing a second set.
listings.howToJoin: Join the Kennett Square Locals Meetup group and attend one of its other events first — the organiser states you must have met them before attending this. The address is sent privately to confirmed attendees. Cancelling within 48 hours, or repeatedly, forfeits a place.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Princeton. Typed as private, not open play, because the description says outright: "We'll play at my house ... I'll send my address privately. I must have met you at a previous event to attend this event." Listing it as open play would send people to something they cannot join. ADDRESS DELIBERATELY WITHHELD — it is the organiser's home and is not published even on Meetup. Three upcoming dates, 13:00-15:00: two Wednesdays (2 and 9 Sep) and one Thursday (17 Sep). Meetup records no series, so "wednesday" follows the majority and the September 17th date is treated as a one-off move; recording "wednesday|thursday" would claim it meets twice a week, which it does not. STYLE NOT STATED by the organiser — recorded as american on the base rate for US social play; confirm before relying on it.
